title: Brazilian Creamy Rice Recipe - Arroz à Piamontese
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup of long grain white  (uncooked and unwashed)
¼ cup of diced onions (roughly half of a small onion)
2 teaspoons of Brazilian Sofrito, or 2 cloves of garlic (, freshly minced)
1 cup of freshly grated parmesan cheese (grated finely)
½ cup of a dry white wine
8 oz can of sliced mushrooms in conserve (, drained)
ldInstructionsRaw: Melt two tablespoons of the butter in a medium pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and the garlic. Sauté just until translucent and fragrant — no browning needed.
Add the unwashed rice to the pan and season with salt to taste. Stir for a few minutes to coat each grain in the butter and aromatics.
Pour in the white wine, and cook just until it’s mostly reduced.

Stir in the stock and bring to a simmer. Then reduce the heat, cover and let it cook gently until the rice is al dente — firm with a little bite. (If the rice isn’t quite done when you check, add around 1-2 tablespoons or water or stock, cover again, and cook a little longer.)
When the rice is just right, stir in heavy cream, the remaining butter, the grated parmesan, and the drained mushrooms. Season with fresh white pepper (or black pepper) to taste.
Want it creamier? Add more cream, more cheese, and more butter to taste — but stir gently to avoid turning everything into mush.
Serve immediately with additional freshly grated parmesan and minced fresh parsley, if desired.
